name: SPARK_METHOD
description: sparklyr connection: databricks (on-cluster) or databricks_connect or local

name: SPARK_CLUSTER_ID
description: Cluster id - databricks_connect only

name: DATABRICKS_HOST
description: Workspace URL - databricks_connect only. DATABRICKS_TOKEN stays in the environment

name: DATABRICKS_CATALOG
description: Catalog for all reads and writes

name: OPTUM_CDM_SCHEMA
description: Optum CDM schema

name: USE_QUARTERLY_TABLES
description: Read the cumulative quarterly CDM tables

name: CODELIST_DIR
description: Where the production code lists live

name: INPUT_COHORT_TABLE
description: The cohort table the LOT run was built over (e.g. ndmm_NDMM_COHORT)

name: OBJECT_PREFIX
description: Prefix for every table this package writes

name: COHORT_PREFIX
description: The cohort build's prefix if it differs from this run's

name: LOT_PREFIX
description: The LOT build's prefix if it differs from this run's
--- study periods: OPEN_QUESTIONS Q1 ---

name: STUDY_START
description: Study period start. Protocol s7.1 text. Figures 1 and 2 say 2016-01-01 - see OPEN_QUESTIONS Q1

name: STUDY_END
description: Study period end; also picks the quarterly table suffix

name: LOT1_INDEX_FROM
description: Earliest 1L initiation that may index the 1L cohort

name: SEC2L_INDEX_FROM
description: Earliest 2L initiation that may index the secondary 2L cohort
--- windows ---

name: BASELINE_DAYS
description: Length of the baseline period before each LOT index

name: MONTHS_AS
description: days or calendar. How a months window is measured - OPEN_QUESTIONS Q21

name: BASELINE_INCLUDES_INDEX
description: Protocol s7.1 excludes the index date from the baseline - OPEN_QUESTIONS Q14

name: COMORBIDITY_BASELINE_INCLUDES_INDEX
description: Protocol s7.8.1 includes it for comorbidities only - OPEN_QUESTIONS Q14

name: GAP_DAYS
description: Enrolment gaps of this many days or fewer are still continuous

name: CE_PRE_DAYS
description: Days of continuous enrolment required before each cohort index date

name: LOT_POST_DISCON_DAYS
description: Days after discontinuation that still belong to that LOT treatment period

name: ACUTE_WASHOUT_DAYS
description: Minimum separation between two acute events of the same type

name: TTE_MIN_POTENTIAL_FU_DAYS
description: Potential follow-up a patient needs to enter the time-to-event analysis set
--- criteria switches: each is an OPEN_QUESTIONS entry ---

name: MM_DX_OUTPATIENT_CODES
description: strict or listed. Which codes the outpatient arm accepts - OPEN_QUESTIONS Q2

name: MM_DX_OUTPATIENT_WINDOW_DAYS
description: Days within which two outpatient MM claims confirm a diagnosis - OPEN_QUESTIONS Q3

name: FU_EVIDENCE_RULE
description: claim_from_index or claim_after_index or enrolled_on_index - OPEN_QUESTIONS Q5

name: PRIOR_TX_DROP_STEROIDS
description: Drop steroid rows from the prior-therapy scan - OPEN_QUESTIONS Q6

name: OTHER_CANCER_PAIR_DAYS
description: Days within which two outpatient cancer claims confirm another cancer

name: OTHER_CANCER_PAIR_GRAIN
description: icd3 or tumor_group. What two claims must share to confirm each other

name: OTHER_CANCER_BOTH_IN_BASELINE
description: Require both claims of a pair inside the baseline window

name: PREGNANCY_WINDOW
description: study_period or patient_period - OPEN_QUESTIONS Q23

name: SEC2L_APPLY_OTHER_CANCER
description: The secondary 2L cohort permits prior malignancy - OPEN_QUESTIONS Q7
--- follow-up and censoring ---

name: CENSOR_AT_DISENROLLMENT
description: Protocol s7.1 ends follow-up at the end of continuous enrolment - OPEN_QUESTIONS Q13

name: BRIDGED_GAP_IS_PERSON_TIME
description: Count the days inside a bridged enrolment gap as covered person-time - OPEN_QUESTIONS Q19
--- demographics ---

name: REGION_SOURCE
description: region_column or state_crosswalk - OPEN_QUESTIONS Q9

name: ENROL_ATTR_AT
description: index_span or latest_span. Which enrolment row supplies a time-varying attribute - OPEN_QUESTIONS Q16

name: ED_DEFINITION
description: Any of revenue pos cpt - how an emergency visit is identified - OPEN_QUESTIONS Q11
--- reporting ---

name: SUPPRESS_MIN_N
description: Stratifications with fewer patients than this are not reported

name: RATE_MULTIPLIER
description: Person-year rates are reported per this many person-years

name: MAX_LOT
description: Highest line this package describes. The LOT engine builds 5
--- selection ---

name: COHORTS
description: Which cohorts to build. Any of 1L 2L 3L SEC2L

name: MODULES
description: Which modules to run. all or a comma-separated list of module keys

name: SKIP_MODULES
description: Modules to leave out of an otherwise-selected set

name: DRY_RUN
description: Resolve and print the plan without touching the warehouse
